title: Insecure data transmission to teacher
description: Student submission data (names, work content, timestamps) transmitted from portal to teacher's device without encryption, risking interception by unauthorized parties.
assumptions: Assumes transmission occurs over unencrypted channels (e.g., HTTP).

title: Unauthorized data disclosure by teacher
description: Teacher may intentionally or accidentally share student submission data with unauthorized individuals (e.g., other staff, students, or external parties).
assumptions: Assumes teacher has access to data beyond their role requirements or lacks proper data handling training.
